exhaustedMorning: You were too worn out to work. The whole morning went.
dinnerMissed: You did not go to the dinner at Thornwall. The next day nobody on the estate mentioned it.
millridgeShortOfTrust: You asked, at Millridge. The two of you are not on those terms yet.
insolvencyDismissed: The Baron’s man came in the morning with half a sheet of paper: payment stops today, hand over within three days.
insolvencyTenantsLeaving: Another day and not one account settled. There were fewer people in the fields than yesterday.
insolvencyRenownSpending: Another day and not one account settled. Word of a thing like that travels fast in the valley.
stewardRescue: Behind a loose board in the office there is a tin the steward before you left there. A few coins — you count them out, enough to keep the gate open a while longer — and a half-sheet of notes in a careful hand. Most of it is figures. One line is not: an empty account, and a valley that has stopped speaking well of you, is a thing no letter of guarantee will hold against. Take the warning with the coin.
stewardRescueLog: You found a tin the last steward left — a little coin, and a warning.
lowFunds:
{@marta}“There is only enough in the kitchen purse for a few days.”

She pulls the neck of the purse tight and puts it back on the top shelf of the cupboard.

{@marta}“There is a market on Saturday,” she says. “Grain and timber both sell there.”
forcedSale:
The Baron’s man has not come yet. The cart from the Valehold grain store has come first.

Elena is standing in the yard with the ledger in her hand. She does not ask you. Of what the barn and the woodpile hold over and above, she has counted out a part, and the carters are loading it at the price the store names. It is a very low price, the kind named when the seller is seen to be in a hurry.

{@elena}“This is not for you,” she says. “It is so that nobody sees this estate stand empty.”

Grain {grain}, timber {timber}, for {gold} guldmark. The figures are on the last page of the ledger.

frostLoss: A hard frost overnight. The grain still standing in the fields came up white with it, and some {lost} units are lost — the slower it comes in, the deeper the frost bites.
